<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(frame,color):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def player_full(frame):
    rows=[];cols=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','W'):
            b=n['boundary']
            rows+=[p[0] for p in b]; cols+=[p[1] for p in b]
    return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)) if rows else None
def items(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='c' and 8<=n['pixels']<=12:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return sorted(out)
# Move player DOWN 2 to get out of conveyor's path, then track conveyor for 6 steps
for i,a in enumerate(['DOWN','DOWN'] + ['DOWN']*6):
    action([a], intent='explore')
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print(f"stopped at {i} {a}:", last_action_result.get('no_impact'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
        break
    print(f"step{i} {a} -> P={player_full(current_frame)} O={pos(current_frame,'O')} items={items(current_frame)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def pos(frame,color):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def player_full(frame):
    rows=[];cols=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','W'):
            b=n['boundary']
            rows+=[p[0] for p in b]; cols+=[p[1] for p in b]
    return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)) if rows else None
def items(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='c' and 8<=n['pixels']<=12:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return sorted(out)
